Hero_Desc_Leets:
A dragon reborn as steel through endless training.
She once had a brave and bold personality, but she has become timid and indecisive for some reason.
There might be some sort of trigger, seeing as how glimpses of her former self can be seen from time to time.
Album_Like_Leets: Feeling that their efforts were not in vain.
Album_Hobby_Leets: Sharpening and maintaining her weapon and armor.
Album_Leets1: Leets is always busy maintaining her armor and sword. She claims that gear maintenance is part of her skills, so she never neglects it. Seeing her gleaming armor and weapon every time we meet, I can tell she's a diligent person.
Album_Leets2: Sist sometimes enters dangerous areas to sell goods or gather materials, and when she does, she hires Leets as a bodyguard. Since Leets ranks low in hierarchy, hiring her is cheap, and despite appearances, her skills are decent, making her a cost-effective choice.
Album_Leets3: Leets once had the chance to duel against Vivi, but Vivi refused, using her condition as an excuse. Leets assumed Vivi didn't want to waste time on a rookie like her and just clicked her tongue in disappointment.
Album_Leets4: I happened to witness Leets in a duel. Contrary to her usual demeanor, she was completely dominating the opponent. After the fight, Leets returned to her usual self and modestly said she barely won. Isn't she being overly humble?
Album_Leets5: According to Daya, Leets was once considered a promising talent among the Dragons. However, at some point, she started growing timid. Although she isn't as withdrawn now as Daya described, it doesn't seem like she's completely overcome it either.
Album_Leets6: Leets makes her own gear, forging weapons and armor deep in the lava zone underground. Her craftsmanship is well-regarded, and some Dragons even leave their gear with Leets for maintenance.
Album_Leets7: Leets dreams of becoming a legendary swordswoman of Elias. Given her diligence, I feel like it's entirely possible... As long as she doesn't end up challenging me to a fight one day.

Food_ChefNote_Leets_Hate1: Leets found it too flashy and shiny for her to eat, expressing it was just too much. I eventually gave her something else to snack on.
Food_ChefNote_Leets_Hate2: Leets criticized it as being too raw. After cold heartily hurting me with a Dutch rub, she tore apart the Banquet Hall muttering that challenges were welcome.
Food_ChefNote_Leets_Like1: Maintaining the empty shape of a cutlet truly calls for a master craftswoman, Leets noted with respect. However, she did not eat it.
Food_ChefNote_Leets_Like2: Leets claims to stock up on these when training alone in the cave. She gave me a few, saying that these Dragon candies taste exceptional after a training.
Food_ChefNote_Leets_Like3: Leets requested for it to be wrapped in small packages, saying it's convenient and compact for training.
Food_ChefNote_Leets_Like4: Leets said she loved the fact it was homemade Songpyeon, it made her appreciate the effort. I wonder if she knows that other foods were also homemade.
Food_ChefNote_Leets_Like5: Leets seems to consider eating this as a form of training. Each time, she stuffs it down in one go, pretending it's nothing.
Food_ChefNote_Leets_Like6: Leets immediately said she couldn't eat a log, when forced to take a bite, she then asked me if this was a lesson about not judging a book by its cover.
Food_ChefNote_Leets_Like7: Leets oddly enjoyed the hot soup, saying it reminded her of the heat of a combat.
Food_ChefNote_Leets_Like8: After happily eating half of it, Leets carefully tucked the remaining Almond Pralines away, planning to have them during training.
Food_ChefNote_Leets_Like9: At first, Leets melted the candies slowly. As it took too long, she ended up crunching them.

LoveLetter_Leets: Hello, Master! Have you been doing well? I finished my daily training as usual and have been wandering around in search of my next opponent! It's absolutely not because Rudd kicked me out of my Roost after nagging at me! So... do you think something worth fighting for will happen in the Order soon? Not that I want anything bad to happen! Just, you know, it would be nice if something exciting came up... Hehe! Anyway, if anything does happen, you have to let me know, Master!
LoveCall_Leets:
Ah, hello, Master.
Um... I thought of you while maintaining my armor.
I-It is not because anything special happened!
For some reason, seeing the armor shine more brightly every time I polished it today made me happy...
It is difficult to explain, but well-maintained swords and armor always lift my spirits!
Hmm. Perhaps they make me feel stronger and safer.

Do you ever have days like that, Master?
Days when everything mysteriously feels certain to go well!
Somehow, I think today is one of those days. Hehe.

Ah, then I should not be standing around!
If I train while I am in good condition, I can rest properly afterward.
I am off to the training grounds! See you next time, Master!
